title: The Evaluator's Chair
description: Drive a Virtuals ACP escrow job: client funds USDC, provider submits a deliverable hash, and whoever sits in the evaluator's chair springs the payout. Seat the client (what ~all of Base does), a neutral agent, or no one — then run it or let someone cheat, and watch who's left exposed.
controls: tap a tab (or ←/→) to choose who sits in the evaluator's chair
tap "run job" for the honest path
tap the cheat button to run the adversarial path for that design
